title: Zesty Crisp Moroccan Black Pudding Tagine
description: A spicy and festive Moroccan dish featuring black pudding, this recipe is perfect for a special occasion. It is kosher-friendly and served in a ramekin.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the katsuramuki-cut black pudding to the skillet and cook until it is browned on all sides.
In a small bowl, mix together the ground cumin, smoked paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Sprinkle the spice mixture over the black pudding in the skillet.
Pour the chicken broth into the skillet and bring the mixture to a boil.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top.
Serve the zesty crisp Moroccan black pudding tagine in a ramekin.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
